tasks.check: deno fmt --check README.md deno.json main.ts main_test.ts src scripts public/app.js public/styles.css .github/workflows && deno lint main.ts main_test.ts src scripts && deno check --unstable-kv main.ts src/*.ts scripts/*.ts && deno test --unstable-kv --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env=HOME,TMPDIR --allow-run=deno main_test.ts src/auth_test.ts scripts/prepare_deploy_root_test.ts
tasks.deploy: deno task deploy:prepare && deno task deploy:kv && deno run --allow-env=DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN,GITHUB_SHA,GITHUB_RUN_ID --allow-net=api.deno.com --allow-read=.deploy-root,deno.json scripts/deploy_deno_api.ts .deploy-root && deno task deploy:verify
